title: Agriculture Subsidy
body: Paglalarawan The Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) provides various government-subsidized agricultural programs to support local farmers and fisherfolk in Mapandan. These programs include subsidies for seeds, fertilizers, farm equipment, and technical assistance to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. Availability of subsidies depends on national and provincial funding allocations. Mga Kinakailangan Farmer registration with the Municipal Agriculture Office Barangay certification of residency and farming activity Farm location and land area information Prosedura Register with the Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) as a farmer or fisherfolk. Secure a barangay certification confirming your farming activity and residency. Submit your registration and requirements to the MAO. Wait for availability announcement of agricultural subsidies or programs. Receive agricultural assistance or subsidies upon program approval. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: Varies (depends on availability) Bayad: Free (government-subsidized) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Agriculture Office, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1873 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Aics
body: Paglalarawan Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) is a government program that provides financial assistance to individuals and families facing emergencies such as medical crises, bereavement, or other unforeseen circumstances. In Mapandan, AICS assistance is administered by the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) in coordination with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD). Mga Kinakailangan Barangay certification stating the resident’s crisis situation Medical certificate (for medical-related assistance) Death certificate (for burial assistance) Valid government-issued ID Case study or social worker assessment Prosedura Secure a barangay certification from your barangay captain or kagawad. Gather all required documents (medical certificate, death certificate, etc.). Visit the MSWDO office and submit your application with supporting documents. Wait for the social worker’s assessment and case study. Receive financial assistance upon approval of your application. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 1–3 working days Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1751 / 0930-641-3934 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Birth Certificate
body: Paglalarawan A birth certificate is a vital record that serves as proof of identity, age, and Filipino citizenship. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered birth certificates. This document is required for school enrollment, passport application, employment, and other legal purposes. Mga Kinakailangan Valid government-issued ID of the requesting party PSA copy of the birth certificate (if available, for verification) Barangay certification of residency (for the person named on the certificate) Affidavit of two disinterested persons (required for delayed registration only) Prosedura Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and present valid identification. Fill out the request form and provide the necessary supporting documents. Pay the certification fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Receive the certified birth certificate upon release. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10 minutes (standard) to 10+ days (late registration) Bayad: ₱115 (standard) / ₱215 (unmarried) / ₱100 (hospital) / ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Building Permit
body: Paglalarawan A building permit is a legal requirement under the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) for any construction, renovation, alteration, or demolition of a building or structure. The Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) of Mapandan reviews and issues building permits after ensuring compliance with safety standards, zoning, and structural requirements. Mga Kinakailangan Plans duly signed & sealed by licensed professionals Certified true copy of Tax Declaration (from Assessor Office) Xerox copy of land title (from Register of Deeds) Community Tax Certificate (from Treasury Office) Latest Tax receipts (from Treasury Office) Electrical & Sanitary permit (from Municipal Health Office) Confirmation of adjoining lot owners Certification from Barangay Captain Application for locational clearance (from Zoning Office) 2 Affidavits (from Notary Public) Affidavit of consent if not lot owner (from Notary Public) Fire Safety clearance (from BFP Office) Affidavit of adjoining lot owners Prosedura Obtain a zoning clearance from the MPDC / Zoning Office. Prepare architectural and structural plans signed by licensed professionals. Submit all documents to the Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) for review. Pay the building permit fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Receive the approved building permit after technical evaluation. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) Klasipikasyon: Highly Technical Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 3 working days (Simple) / 7 working days (Complex) / 20 working days (Highly Technical) per RA 11032 Bayad: Based on project cost (schedule per National Building Code) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Engineering Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Business Permit
body: Paglalarawan A business permit is required for all individuals or entities intending to operate a commercial business within the Municipality of Mapandan. This permit is issued after compliance with documentary and safety requirements and upon payment of applicable fees. Mga Kinakailangan Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office) DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application) BIR COR, if available (from RDO Calasiao) Barangay Clearance (System Integrated) Prosedura Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min). BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System. BPLO endorses applicant to various offices: Engineering (Occupancy Certificate), MPDC (Zoning Certificate), RHU (Health Certificate & Sanitary Permit), BFP (Fire Safety Inspection Certificate) (44 min). Pay fees and charges at the Treasury Office. Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of Business Permit. Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office (10 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1 hour (10 min encoding + 44 min endorsement + 10 min pay & claim) Bayad: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200) Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Business Renewal
body: Paglalarawan Businesses operating within Mapandan are required to renew their business permits annually. Renewal ensures that your business remains compliant with local regulations and avoids penalties for late filing. Mga Kinakailangan Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office) DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application) BIR COR (from RDO Calasiao) Barangay Clearance (System Integrated) Prosedura Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min). BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System. BPLO endorses applicant to Engineering, MPDC, RHU, and BFP for required certificates (44 min). Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Fees include Mayor's Permit, Business Tax (% of Gross Sales), Plate & Sticker, Weights & Measure, Storage Fee, and Garbage Fee. Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of renewed Business Permit. Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1 hour (similar to new business permit process) Bayad: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Tax (% of Gross Sales) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200) Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Cedula
body: Paglalarawan The Community Tax Certificate (cedula) is computed as follows: Individual — ₱5.00 basic + ₱1.00 for every ₱1,000 gross income from business, profession, or property, but in no case shall exceed ₱5,000.00. Juridical — ₱500.00 basic + ₱2.00 for every ₱5,000 gross income from business or worth of real property, but in no case shall exceed ₱10,000.00. Interest of 24% per annum shall be imposed on individual or juridical securing their CTC from March 1 up to the end of the year. Mga Kinakailangan Old Community Tax Certificate (if available) Proof of income (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 1 and 2 and fill up the basic data form (15 min). Pay the required fees (3 min). Receive community tax certificate. Staff records in general collection system (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 20 minutes (15 min form filling + 3 min payment + 2 min recording) Bayad: Individual: ₱5 + ₱1/₱1k income (max ₱5,000); Juridical: ₱500 + ₱2/₱5k income (max ₱10,000); 24% interest from March 1 Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Health Consultation
body: Paglalarawan The Municipal Health Office (MHO) / Rural Health Unit (RHU) provides free health consultation services to all residents of Mapandan. This includes general medical consultations, health advice, and referrals to higher-level health facilities when necessary. Walk-in patients are served on a first-come, first-served basis. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Prosedura Register in Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife registers new patients and encodes data. Classify patient: PhilHealth member (attach ID number) or non-PhilHealth member. Record consultation date, vital signs, and chief complaint. Occupy seats in waiting area and wait for name to be called. MHO check-up, assess, and treat the patient. Schedule follow-up check-up. Give available medicines to patient and encode. title: Land Transfer
body: Paglalarawan Transfer of land ownership is the legal process of transferring property rights from one owner to another. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) records the transfer and updates the Tax Declaration under the new owner's name. The client first secures a tax clearance from the Treasury Office, then submits the transfer documents to the Assessor's Office. The Assessor records the transaction, cancels the old Tax Declaration, and issues a new one. Fee: ₱150 for recording. Mga Kinakailangan Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, or other proof of transfer Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration (from Assessor's Office) Valid Government-issued ID of the new owner BIR Certificate of Registration (if applicable) Prosedura Secure a Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office. Obtain a Certified True Copy of the Tax Declaration from the Assessor's Office. Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office. Assessor reviews and records the transfer (15 min). Assessor cancels the old Tax Declaration and prepares the new one (10 min). Pay ₱150 recording fee at the Treasury Office. Claim the new Tax Declaration under the new owner's name (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (Assessor recording); full transfer may take 15–30 working days Bayad: ₱150 (recording fee at Assessor's Office) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Marriage License
body: Paglalarawan A marriage license is a legal requirement before a marriage can be solemnized in the Philippines. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan processes marriage license applications, which include a required publication period. The license is valid for 120 days from the date of issuance. Mga Kinakailangan Municipal Form No. 90 Community Tax Certificate (cedula) Parental Consent of father/guardian (from MCR) Certificate of Family Planning (from Mun Health Office) Certificate of Pre-Marriage Counselling (from MSWD Office) CENOMAR / Birth Certificate (from PSA) Legal Capacity (from DFA, if one party is a foreigner) Prosedura Both parties appear at the MCR and submit all required documents. Fill out the marriage license application form. Pay the applicable fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Wait for the 10-day publication period. After publication, claim the marriage license from the MCR. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10–15 working days (including 10-day publication period) Bayad: ₱862 Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Name Correction
body: Paglalarawan Republic Act No. 9048 authorizes the city or municipal civil registrar to correct clerical or typographical errors in civil registry entries without the need for a judicial order. This covers corrections in first names, nicknames, or minor spelling errors. This process does not apply to changes in gender, date of birth, or other substantive entries. Mga Kinakailangan Proof of Publication (from PSA) Certificate of Live Birth (from PSA) NBI Clearance Police Clearance (from PNP) Certificate of Employment (if employed) / Affidavit of non-employment Marriage Certificate, Medical records, SSS records, land title, baptismal certificate Prosedura Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and submit all required documents. File the petition for correction of clerical error. Pay the required fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Wait for the publication period to be completed. After publication and verification, claim the corrected birth certificate from the MCR. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10-day posting + 5 days MCR decision + 2–3 months PSA processing Bayad: ₱3,000 (change of first name) / ₱1,000 (correction of clerical error) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Rpt Payment
body: Paglalarawan Real property tax (RPT) is an annual tax on the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements within Mapandan. Computation: Basic Tax = 1% of Assessed Value + Special Education Tax (SEF) = 1% of Assessed Value. Discounts: 10% for prompt payment, 20% for advance payment. Interest on unpaid real property tax: 2% per month but not to exceed 72%. Payment is processed at Counters 4-9 of the Treasury Office. Mga Kinakailangan Real Property Tax bill (from Assessor's Office) Previous Tax receipt (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 4 to 9 and request computation of real property tax. Staff computes the real property tax due (20 min). Pay the required fees (5 min). Receive the official receipt. Staff records in general collection system (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (20 min computation + 5 min payment + 5 min recording) Bayad: Basic Tax (1% of AV) + SEF (1% of AV); 10% prompt payment discount; 20% advance payment discount Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter / Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020 Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Sanitary Permit
body: Paglalarawan A sanitary permit is required for all businesses that handle food, beverages, or other consumable products to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards. The permit is issued by the Municipal Health Office (MHO) after an inspection of the business premises to verify that health and safety regulations are met. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Laboratory Tests: CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, sputum exam, Hepatitis B (from RHU Primary Laboratory) Chest X-Ray, PA (from government or private diagnostic facility) Prosedura Present official receipt from the Treasury Office. Laboratory examination of urine, feces, sputum is conducted by Medical Technologist (30 min). Refer to other laboratories for X-ray if needed (2 min). Refer result to MHO for interpretation (10 min). MHO does physical examination and interprets result (5 min). MHO prescribes medicines if needed (2 min). MHO signs the certification (2 min). List down certificate number on logbook and release certification (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Rural Health Unit (RHU) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 53 minutes per client Bayad: ₱130 (laboratory tests) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Health Office, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1874 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Senior Pwd Id
body: Paglalarawan The Senior Citizen ID and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID are government-issued identification cards that provide holders with benefits and privileges under the law. Senior Citizens (60 years old and above) and PWDs are entitled to discounts, tax exemptions, and other benefits as mandated by RA 9994 (Senior Citizens Act) and RA 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons). The IDs are processed through the MSWDO and MCR in coordination with the national implementing agencies. Mga Kinakailangan Birth certificate or PSA-issued document as proof of age (for Senior Citizens) Barangay certification of residency Two (2) pieces of 2x2 ID photos Medical certificate (for PWD applicants, indicating the nature of disability) Prosedura Secure a barangay certification of residency from your barangay office. For PWD applicants, obtain a medical certificate indicating the nature and severity of the disability. Submit all required documents to the MSWDO or MCR office. Wait for verification and processing of your application. Receive your Senior Citizen or PWD ID upon approval. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: MSWDO + MCR Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 3–5 working days Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1751 / 0930-641-3934 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Special Event Permit
body: Paglalarawan A special event permit is required for individuals or organizations planning to hold public events within Mapandan. This includes festivals, concerts, trade fairs, sports tournaments, and other gatherings that may affect public roads, spaces, or safety. Mga Kinakailangan Event proposal with detailed description, expected attendance, and schedule Sketch or map of the event venue Safety and security plan Event insurance (if applicable, depending on event type and size) Barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will be held Prosedura Secure a barangay endorsement from the barangay where the event will take place. title: Tax Declaration
body: Paglalarawan A tax declaration is an official document that shows the assessed value of your real property for taxation purposes. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) of Mapandan issues certified true copies of Tax Declarations upon request. This document is required for property sales, loans, insurance applications, tax payments, and other legal transactions. The client submits a written request with property details and the Assessor's Office locates the record, prepares the certified true copy, and releases it upon payment. Mga Kinakailangan Written request stating the property location (lot number, block, street, barangay) Valid Government-issued ID Prosedura Submit a written request with property details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office. Staff receives and verifies the request (5 min). Staff locates the Tax Declaration in the records (5 min). Staff prepares the certified true copy and stamps it (3 min). Pay ₱100 at the Treasury Office and claim the document (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 15 minutes Bayad: ₱100 per certified true copy Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Contact: (075) 696-0831 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Certificate Of Indigency
body: Paglalarawan The Certificate of Indigency is issued by the MSWDO to indigent families certified by the Barangay Captain. This document is required to avail of various services including hospital discounts, legal assistance from the Public Attorney's Office (PAO), scholarship assistance for college education, and other social welfare programs. The MSWDO conducts an interview and assessment to verify the client's eligibility before issuing the certificate. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate (if hospitalized) Police report / Police blotter / RTC/MTC report (if applicable) Report Card Form 138 / Recommendation (if for students) Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR) Prosedura Register at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you and conduct an initial interview. Submit your Barangay Certificate of Indigency and other supporting documents. Staff will conduct an interview and assess your eligibility for assistance. Receive your Certificate of Indigency upon approval. title: Solo Parent Id
body: Paglalarawan The Solo Parent ID is issued by the MSWDO to qualifying solo parents as mandated by RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000). Holders are entitled to benefits including flexible work arrangements, educational assistance for children, and health care privileges. The MSWDO assesses eligibility using the solo parent intake form. Processing includes a 6-month assessment period before the ID is issued. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate Birth Certificate of minor child/children under custody 1x1 picture Prosedura Register at the MSWDO and submit your requirements. Staff will check and verify your submitted documents. Submit your requirements and undergo assessment using the solo parent intake form. After 6 months of assessment, the Solo Parent ID is recorded in the logbook and issued. title: Pwd Assistive Devices
body: Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides assistive devices such as crutches, wheelchairs, prosthesis, and other gadgets to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) to help them integrate into the mainstream of community life. The service covers orthopedically handicapped, visually impaired, and immobile individuals aged 0–59 years old. The MSWDO coordinates with PSWDO and DSWD Field Office I for funding and procurement of devices. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate with doctor's recommendation for assistive device Whole body picture Prosedura Apply at the MSWDO. A family member may represent the client. Staff will interview and gather relevant information from the client or family member. Submit Barangay Certificate, Medical Certificate, and whole body picture. MSWDO conducts follow-up, home visit, and assesses eligibility and device needs. MSWDO prepares and submits documents to PSWDO/DSWD FO1 for funding and purchase. Receive the assistive device (crutches, wheelchair, prosthesis, etc.) upon availability. title: Osca Death Aid
body: Paglalarawan The OSCA Death Aid Benefits provide financial assistance to families of deceased Senior Citizens. The benefit is processed through the MSWDO upon submission of the deceased's original death certificate, two photocopies of the OSCA ID, and surrender of the OSCA ID. The MSWDO prepares the application and submits reports to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of Indigency Death Certificate (original copy) OSCA ID (original + two photocopies) Prosedura Register at the MSWDO. Staff will conduct intake interview and assess eligibility. Submit the deceased's original Death Certificate, two photocopies of OSCA ID, and surrender the OSCA ID. MSWDO prepares the Application Form and Certificate of Eligibility. MSWDO submits report with attached documents to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Follow up with the MSWDO for the status of financial assistance. Receive the OSCA financial assistance at the Municipal Treasury Office. title: Social Case Study
body: Paglalarawan A Social Case Study Report is issued to clients who need to avail of assistance from PCSO, other government hospitals, institutions, NGOs, DSWD, and various foundations. The report is prepared by MSWDO social workers after a thorough assessment that includes an initial interview, home visit, and evaluation of the client's situation. The report serves as a supporting document for various forms of assistance. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of Indigency from Barangay Captain Medical Certificate / Clinical Abstract / Medico-Legal report Police report / Police blotter (if applicable) Whole body picture Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR) Psychiatric Evaluation Report (as needed) Prosedura Apply at the MSWD Office. Staff will refer you for initial interview. Discuss your problem and provide relevant information. Staff conducts initial interview and gathers data. Staff may conduct a home visit or follow-up, especially for CICL cases. Submit Barangay Certificate of Indigency and other required documents. MSWDO prepares and computerizes the Social Case Study Report. Receive your copy of the Social Case Study Report upon approval. title: Disaster Relief
body: Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides disaster relief assistance and rehabilitation services to families affected by floods, typhoons, fires, and other calamities. The service includes verification of affected families, distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC, and financial assistance (ESA) for families whose houses are totally destroyed. The MSWDO coordinates with the LGU, PSWDO, and DSWD Field Office I. Mga Kinakailangan Master list of affected families (from Barangay Captain) Barangay certificate Certificate of Indigency Prosedura Report to the Barangay Captain the extent of damage. The Captain validates and forwards the list to MSWDO. MSWDO attends MDDC meeting conducted by the Local Chief Executive. MSWDO receives list of affected families and endorses to concerned social worker. Verification and inspection team (with Engineering, PNP, DSWD) assesses the damage. MSWDO requests and lobbies for allocation of relief goods from LGU, PSWDO, DSWD FO1. Distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC. For totally destroyed houses, MSWDO prepares project proposal for ESA funding. Financial assistance (ESA) is distributed to qualified beneficiaries. MSWDO monitors and evaluates project implementation for house repair/reconstruction. title: Pre Natal
body: Paglalarawan The RHU provides pre-natal consultation services for antenatal women. The service includes registration in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), OB history, vital signs, Leopold's maneuver, fetal heartbeat assessment, and fundic height measurement. Routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg, RPR) are requested. The MHO conducts complete physical examination, interprets laboratory results, and provides health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. High-risk patients are referred to higher-level facilities. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Medical Records, Laboratory Results, Prescription for Medicines (from previous physician, if any) Prosedura Register in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Midwife encodes OB history, vital signs, and performs Leopold's maneuver. Request for routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg Screening, RPR test). MHO performs complete physical examination and interprets laboratory results. If high-risk, patient is referred to a higher level of facility. Health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. Data encoding, obstetric history, and vital signs are recorded during the consultation. title: Tb Dots
body: Paglalarawan The RHU provides Directly Observed Treatment Short Course (TB DOTS) for patients with tuberculosis. The service includes registration, sputum examination, GeneXpert/TBDC testing, physical examination, and provision of anti-TB drugs with proper intake instructions. The MHO maintains patient confidentiality and monitors treatment compliance. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Medical Records, Prescription of Medicines (from previous physician, if any) Chest X-Ray PA Result (from government or private diagnostic facility) Prosedura Register in the log book. Midwife encodes data, vital signs, and asks about symptoms and duration. Submit sputum for examination. Sputum examination is conducted. Patient is referred to GeneXpert/TBDC for further testing. Consent is secured and confidentiality is maintained. MHO conducts physical examination of patient. Anti-TB drugs are given with record and patient is advised on proper intake. The MHO provides a laboratory request, and the Medical Technologist conducts the examination. Results are interpreted by the MHO who prescribes medications as needed. Midwife encodes data, vital signs, and asks about symptoms. MHO conducts physical examination and requests laboratory tests. Submit specimen for testing. Available tests: ABO/RH typing (₱100), Pregnancy test (₱50), CBC (₱150), Urinalysis (₱65), Fecalysis (₱65), Hepatitis B screening (₱200), FBS (₱100). Subsequent doses cost ₱350 each. Mga Kinakailangan Rabies exposure case (bite or scratch) Prosedura Register in the log book. Midwife classifies patient (new/old, PhilHealth member, emergency/senior citizen priority). Record patient's data, vital signs, and bite/scratch details. MHO performs wound/scratch assessment and provides counselling. MHO prescribes rabies vaccine or immunoglobulin (as applicable). ABTC Nurse administers anti-rabies vaccine and/or immunoglobulin. ABTC Nurse provides post-treatment instructions and follow-up schedule. Pharmacy Assistant dispenses vaccines or medicine. title: Nutrition Immunization
body: Paglalarawan The RHU implements the Nutrition Program for malnourished children (0–59 months and older) and the National Immunization Program (NIP) for children against vaccine-preventable diseases. The nutrition program includes assessment, deworming, feeding with nutrient-dense food, and monthly monitoring. The immunization program administers age-appropriate vaccines after reviewing the child's records and checking vital signs. Mga Kinakailangan Birth Certificate (Municipal Civil Registry) Medical Records, Vaccination Records (from hospital of birth or pediatrician) Prosedura For malnourished children (0–59 months): Barangay Nutrition Scholar assesses weight and height. Physician refers to RHU for deworming and medical intervention. Child is fed with nutrient-dense food (high carbohydrate and protein). Monthly monitoring of weight, height, and alertness. For immunization: BHW interviews child's information and reviews records. Midwife checks vital signs (weight and temperature). Midwife administers age-appropriate vaccine. Midwife advises parent on child care and expected outcome. Schedule next vaccination. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Opisyo na May Pananagutan: Rural Health Unit (RHU) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 50 minutes per client Bayad: Free Saan Mag-aapply: Rural Health Unit, Poblacion Contact: (075) 632-1874 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Nascanned na Dokumento Nascanned na pahina mula sa opisyal na Mapandan Citizen's Charter na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayad, oras ng pagproseso, at mga staff na may pananagutan para sa serbisyo. title: Electrical Zoning
body: Paglalarawan A zoning clearance is required for electrical permits. The MPDC/Zoning Office evaluates the application, conducts land use assessment, and issues the Zoning Compliance Certificate for electrical installations. The process includes site evaluation/inspection, computation of fees, and approval by the Zoning Officer. Mga Kinakailangan Application for Zoning Permit (from MPDC) Accomplished Individual Assessment for Application of Temporary Housing Unit Form Tax Declaration of lot (from Assessor Office) Current Tax receipts (from Treasury Office) Affidavit of consent of lot owner Site development sketch indicating the ROW Affidavit of consent for Right of Way (from lot owner) Certification from Barangay Captain Prosedura Inquire at the MPDC office and secure the application form. MPDC staff conducts interview and provides forms. Accomplish forms and prepare all required documents. MPDC checks and evaluates forms and required documents. Request for site evaluation/inspection. Land use assessment conducted. Go to Zoning office for computation of fees and charges. Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Present receipts to MPDC. Submit one photocopy of all forms and documents. body: Paglalarawan The Office of the Sangguniang Bayan provides financial assistance to indigent residents of Mapandan. Cash is released for amounts ₱3,000 and below; checks are issued for amounts exceeding ₱3,000. An authorization letter is required if a representative claims on behalf of the beneficiary. title: Seed Certification
body: Paglalarawan The Municipal Agriculturist provides technical and extension services for seed certification. The service includes seed sampling in the presence of the Seed Inspector, laboratory analysis, and issuance of seed tags. Available to registered members of the Seed Grower Association. The Municipal Agriculturist coordinates with the Seeds Laboratory for analysis. Mga Kinakailangan Membership in Seed Grower Association Actual harvest date notification to Seeds Inspector Prosedura Submit/show requirements and inform the Seeds Inspector of the actual date of harvest. Municipal Agriculturist confirms presence at the date of harvest (10 min). Gather seed samples in the presence of the Seed Inspector and submit to the seed laboratory for analysis (10 min). Seeds Laboratory analyzes seed samples, tags, and prepares report (15 min). Receive result of the seed analysis and sign log book. Seeds Inspector delivers seed tags and discusses results (15 min). The permit is issued after all clearances are obtained. title: Birth Registration
body: Paglalarawan Registration of birth at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers three pathways: (1) Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth — requires Marriage Certificate of parents and Mun. Form 102; (2) Unmarried parents — requires Community Tax Certificate; (3) Hospital administrator — requires Accomplished Mun. Form 102. Late registration requires negative PSA certification and supporting documents. Fees: Misc Fee ₱115 (standard), ₱215 (unmarried), ₱100 (hospital), ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration depending on age). Mga Kinakailangan Marriage Certificate of parents from PSA (for attending midwife/hilot registration) Community Tax Certificate from Treasury Office (for unmarried parents) Accomplished Mun. Form 102 from MCR (for hospital registration) Negative certification from PSA (for late registration) Affidavit of delayed registration (for late registration) Supporting evidence: Baptismal Certificate, School records, ITR, Insurance Policy, Medical records, Barangay certification (for late registration) Prosedura Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth. MCR evaluates information and registers (10 min). For unmarried parents: Hospital admin or representative prepares documents (15 min). For late registration: Apply at MCR, verify from CRIS/Registry Book. If negative, submit requirements. Data typed in Certificate of Live Birth (15 min typing). MCR approves registration (after 10 days of posting for late registration). Secure copy of birth certificate. MCR releases documents (3 min). title: Legal Document Registration
body: Paglalarawan Registration of legal documents at the Municipal Civil Registrar. body: Paglalarawan The Municipal Assessor's Office conducts appraisal of newly declared titled real property to determine its assessed value for taxation purposes. body: Paglalarawan The Population Office facilitates group enrollment of indigent residents to PhilHealth under the Local Government Unit (LGU)-sponsored program. title: Legislative
body: Framework Lokal na pamamahala at mga pinagmulan ng batas Legal Basis Ang Bayan ng Mapandan ay gumagana sa ilalim ng Republic Act Blg. 7160 (Local Government Code ng 1991), matatagpuan sa Ikatlong Kongresonal na Distrito ng Pangasinan. Ang Sangguniang Bayan — isang unicameral na lokal na lehislatibong konseho — ang nagsasagawa ng municipal legislative power, pinamumunuan ng Municipal Vice Mayor at binubuo ng mga halal na konsehal kasama ang mga ex-officio representatives mula sa Liga ng mga Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Federation. Mga Pinagmulan ng Kasaysayan Originally an agricultural barrio of Mangaldan referred to as balon baley ("new town"), Mapandan was first established as an independent pueblo pursuant to Direction General No. 39, Administration Civil No. 169-C, promulgated by Governor General Emilio Bravo on December 28, 1887. Following population and fiscal losses caused by an epidemic in 1905 that temporarily reverted Mapandan to Mangaldan's jurisdiction, the municipality was re-established under American civil administration through Executive Order No. 10, signed by Governor General James F. Smith in 1909. No. 5, S-2024 Process Flow How an ordinance becomes law The legislative pipeline under the Local Government Code of 1991. 1 Filing A proposed ordinance is filed with the Sangguniang Bayan for consideration. 2 First Reading Initial reading and referral to the relevant committee for review. 3 Committee Hearing The committee holds hearings and deliberates on the proposal. 4 Committee Report Findings and recommendations are submitted back to the full council. 5 Second Reading Detailed floor discussion and debate on the proposed ordinance. 6 Third & Final Reading Final vote by the Sangguniang Bayan. 7 Mayor's Approval The Municipal Mayor reviews and approves the enacted ordinance. 8 Provincial Review Submitted to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan for legal review under Sections 56 and 57 of R.A. 7160. 9 Posting & Effect The approved ordinance is posted publicly and takes effect across all 15 constituent barangays. Key Distinction Ordinance vs. Resolution Under the Local Government Code of 1991, the Sangguniang Bayan enacts two types of legislative measures: Ordinance A legislative measure that enacts a permanent rule or policy . Ordinances carry the force of law, create offices, levy taxes, or regulate conduct. They require three readings, publication, and the Mayor's approval (or passage by 2/3 override of a veto). Resolution A legislative measure that expresses the sentiment, intent, or opinion of the Sangguniang Bayan on a specific matter. Resolutions are used for internal housekeeping, requesting national action, or authorizing one-time transactions. They require only one reading and are not subject to publication.
